title: Helsinki’s visual identity

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Explain why shared recognition matters when residents need to identify which services belong to their city.
strategic_value: A common identity can make Helsinki’s many operators easier to recognize as one civic organization.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section pairs five reasons for consistency with a collage of formerly separate agency marks and a caption describing residents’ confusion.
practical_value: Use the former-logo collage to assess whether an identity system makes service ownership recognizable.
